title: 新入社員の毎日
subject_en: A young Japanese new employee, short black hair, light skin, navy suit, white shirt, dot eyes, smiling, flat business illustration, 4-head-tall; the same person on every cell. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 名刺交換、電話対応、おじぎ、メモ、報連相など、新入社員の場面12点。研修資料や入社案内、マニュアルに。
items: exchanging business cards with both hands
answering a phone call with a notepad
taking notes in a notebook while listening
reporting to a senior colleague at a desk
sitting in a training session looking at a screen
walking through an office door with a bag
looking worried with a hand on the head over papers
raising a glass at a welcome party
